# Mikhail Bahdashych

> Personal site and blog of Mikhail Bahdashych, a security engineer working across GRC and compliance (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2), security operations and AI security.

## Pages

- [About](https://mikhailbahdashych.me/about): work history, education and certifications
- [Blog](https://mikhailbahdashych.me/blog): write-ups on security engineering
- [Projects](https://mikhailbahdashych.me/projects): security tooling and infrastructure projects

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://mikhailbahdashych.me/rss.xml): all articles
- [Sitemap](https://mikhailbahdashych.me/sitemap.xml): every public page
